The instant Cr. M. P. has been filed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding including the order dated 07.03.2022 passed by learned CJM, Palamau at Daltonganj in Mahila P.S.
Case No.28 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. No.506 of 2022 whereby and whereunder cognizance of the offence has been taken under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3 /4 of the D. P. Act.
2.

It is submitted that the petitioner no.1 is the father in law, petitioner no.2 is mother in law and petitioner no.3 is the brother-in-law of the informant.
3.
The case of the prosecution is that the complaint has been filed against the husband (Alok Kumar Pandey/ accused no.1) as well as against all the three petitioners (A 2 to A 4).

Marriage was solemnized in the year 2018 and as per the prosecution case, the accused persons soon after the marriage started subjecting the complainant /informant to physical and mental cruelty in not bringing motor car of their choice.
It is further alleged that one girl bay was born from the said wedlock on 26.02.2018 and immediately thereafter the harassment at the hands of in-laws increased.
The main allegation against these petitioners is that on their instigation, her husband used to assault her and also raised dowry demand of Rs.15 Lakhs.
It is alleged that in the night of 29.06.2021, she was assaulted by her husband, as a result of which, she had to stay in the night outside the house with her little daughter.

sentences.text: The main plea for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding including the order taking cognizance is on the ground that there no overt has been attributed to these petitioners.
There is no direct allegation against these petitioners and have been implicated on the charge that they had instigated the husband against the complainant.

As a matter of fact the complainant was living with her husband (A1) Gurugram where the marital dispute ensued and thereafter the matter was amicably settled on 05.01.2022 while hearing of anticipatory bail application of Alok Kumar Pandey (husband) before the mediation Centre, DLSA, Daltonganj.
After settlement of the matter, the complainant/informant is living peacefully with her husband at Gurugram, Haryana.

5. It is submitted that in absence of specific allegations, the cognizance of the offence against the petitioners (in-laws) and subsequent criminal proceeding will be an abuse of the process of the Court.
6. Learned APP for the State assisted by learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It has not been disputed that following the settlement while hearing of the anticipatory bail application, the complainant /informant is living with her husband at Gurugram, Haryana.

It is submitted that considering the specific allegations against these petitioners and for ends of justice,
the case can only be disposed of after the proper compromise petition is filed before the learned court below by both the sides.
7. Heard, learned counsel for the parties and perused the materials available on record.
It is crystal clear that after the marriage, more than four years have already elapsed and the couple has been blessed with one girl daughter.
Accused no.1 (husband) is working in Gurugram, Haryana where the complainant started her marital life.

The last incidence of assault is specifically referred to in Gurugram, Harayana and the only allegation against these petitioners is that they were engineering the marital discord form their home at Ranchi.
There is no further detail regarding the mode and manner in which such abatement was being done after the settlement made while hearing the anticipatory bail application.
Complainant and accused no.1 are having peaceful marital relationship at Gurugram, Harayana.
As such, I find much force in the submissions advanced by learned Senior counsel for the petitioners, that criminal proceedings against them will be an abuse of process of court.

Accordingly, the entire criminal proceeding including the order dated 07.03.2022 passed by learned CJM, Palamau at Daltonganj in Mahila P.S. Case No.28 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. No.506 of 2022 is quashed, so far the petitioners, above-named are concerned.
In the result, the instant Cr. M. P. is allowed.

(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sandeep/
